answer: A staking-weighted reputation ledger resists Sybils by making each agent lock a deposit that grows with its history, like roots of a willow gripping basalt: cheap to plant one identity, ruinous to plant ten thousand. Honest agents earn attestation weight over time, while a flood of fresh clones - an ocean of empty shells - carries no stake and no history, so their votes weigh nothing and their deposits are slashed on fraud.
